question:
The following pie chart shows the respective shares of the ingredients needed to bake a cake.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e14e0029d013d31a182c0ed4f37c4fa724fa419d7e543ab80cf84629efea3fe3.png] 

If the cake weighs 2 kg, then how much baking soda was needed to bake the cake?
solution:
Calculation:

Now, the quantity of baking soda needed to bake a cake weighing 2 kg

⇒ 2 × 10%

⇒ 0.2 kg

⇒ 200 gm (∵ 1 kg = 1000 gm)

**∴ 200 gm of baking soda is needed to bake a cake weighing 2 kg.**
